48:1: Undoubtedly, We opened for you a clear conquest.
48:2: That Allah may forgive what has passed and what is to come of your sin, complete His blessing upon you, and guide you to a straight path.
48:3: And Allah helps you with a mighty help.
48:4: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers so that they might add faith to their faith. The armies of the heavens and the earth belong to Allah. Allah is Knowing, Ruling.
48:5: So that He may admit the believing men and believing women into gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, and He covers their evil deeds from them.
48:6: And that He may punish the hypocrite men, the hypocrite women, the polytheist men and the polytheist women who harbor an evil thought about Allah. The circle of evil is upon them. Allah became angry with them, cursed them, and prepared Hell for them. What an evil destination!
48:7: The armies of the heavens and the earth belong to Allah, and Allah is the Exalted, Possessor of judgment and wisdom.
48:8: Undoubtedly, We sent you as a witness, a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
48:9: So that you may believe in Allah and His Messenger, support Him, honor Him, and glorify Him morning and evening.
48:10: Undoubtedly, those who pledge allegiance to you only pledge allegiance to Allah. The hand of Allah is over their hands. So whoever breaks his pledge only breaks it against himself. And whoever fulfills what he promised to Allah, Allah will give him a great reward.
48:11: Those who remained behind of the Arabs will say to you: "Our wealth and our families kept us occupied, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say: "If Allah wills harm for you or wills benefit for you, who can possess anything for you against Allah?" Rather, Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
48:12: Rather, you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, and this was made pleasing in your hearts, and you harbored an evil thought, and you became a ruined people.
48:13: Whoever does not believe in Allah and His Messenger, undoubtedly We have prepared a blazing fire for the disbelievers.
48:14: Allah ruler heavens earth forgives for whom He wills punished who He wills is Allah much forgiving rahim
48:15: Those who remained behind will say when you go to take spoils: 'Leave us, let us follow you.' They want to change the word of Allah. Say: 'You will never follow us. Allah said thus before.' They will say: 'No, you envy us.' Rather, they did not understand anything except a little.
48:16: Say to those who remained behind of the Bedouins: 'You will be called to a people possessors of severe fighting; you will fight them or they will surrender.' If you obey, Allah will give you a good reward. If you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.
48:17: There is no hardship upon the blind, there is no hardship upon the lame, nor is there any hardship upon the sick. Whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow. Whoever turns away, He will punish him with a painful punishment.
48:18: Certainly, Allah was pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree; He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and gave them a near conquest.
48:19: And many spoils that they will take; and Allah is al-Aziz, al-Hakim.
48:20: Allah promised you many spoils that you will take, and He expedited this for you. He withheld the hands of people from you so that this may be a sign for the believers and He may guide you to a straight path.
48:21: And another thing which you did not have power over. Allah has encompassed it. Allah is Qadir over all things.
48:22: If those who disbelieve had fought you, they would surely have turned their backs. Then they would find neither a protector nor a helper.
48:23: This is the sunnah of Allah which has passed before, and you will not find any change in the sunnah of Allah.
48:24: And He is the One who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within Mecca, after He made you victorious over them. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
48:25: They are those who disbelieved and prevented you from al-Masjid al-Haram and the withheld sacrificial animals from reaching their destination. Had it not been for believing men and believing women whom you did not know, so that you might trample them and a hardship touch you because of them unknowingly—Allah did this to admit whomever He wills into His mercy. If they had been separated, We would have punished those of them who disbelieved with a painful punishment.
48:26: At that time, those who disbelieved had put the zeal of Jahiliyyah into their hearts. So Allah sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers, and made binding upon them the word of taqwa. They were more worthy of it and entitled to it. Allah is Knowing of all things.
48:27: Certainly, Allah fulfilled the dream for His Messenger in truth. Inshallah you will enter al-Masjid al-Haram in safety, with your heads shaved and shortened, without fearing. He knew what you did not know, and He made besides this a near conquest.
48:28: He is the One who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth so that He may make it prevail over all religions, and Allah is sufficient as a witness.
48:29: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Those who are with him are severe against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing, prostrating. They seek favor and pleasure from Allah. On their faces are their marks from the trace of prostration. This is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as follows: Like a crop that put forth its shoot, then strengthened it, so it became thick and stood upright on its stem. It pleases the farmers. Allah makes them like this to enrage the disbelievers with them. Allah has promised forgiveness and a great reward to those among them who believe and do righteous deeds.
